intended_use: Verify the covered atomic operations on the current Challenge 7 source
target: Current verify-rust-std atomic implementation, Linux x86-64 and AArch64 Linux proof targets

BOOL-SAFETY.behavior: The Boolean conversion and ordinary store preserve lifetime and memory safety under the documented access rules

U16-SAFETY.behavior: Ordinary AtomicU16 constructor, load and store preserve aligned live storage and enforce access permissions.

PTR-SAFETY.behavior: AtomicPtr converts a live aligned initialized pointer slot and performs ordinary pointer accesses with the required storage permissions.

CONSTRUCTOR-COVERAGE.behavior: Every required from_ptr constructor meets the slot safety contract on a target that exposes it.

EXCHANGE-SAFETY.behavior: Atomic exchange preserves slot validity and lifetime and requires full atomic byte permission on the covered types and target.

COMPARE-EXCHANGE-SAFETY.behavior: Strong and weak compare-exchange preserve slot validity and lifetime under full atomic byte permissions, including valid storage on unwind for invalid failure orderings.

ARITHMETIC-SAFETY.behavior: Addition and subtraction preserve live aligned storage under full atomic byte permission for the supported integer and thin pointer types.

BITWISE-SAFETY.behavior: Atomic AND, NAND, OR and XOR preserve live aligned storage under full atomic byte permission. The Boolean wrappers preserve the Boolean byte invariant.

EXTREMA-SAFETY.behavior: Signed and unsigned minimum and maximum preserve live aligned storage and the slot invariant when the supplied value satisfies it.

INTEGER-ACCESS-SAFETY.behavior: Ordinary integer loads and stores preserve initialized and aligned storage. Loads accept read permission and stores require full atomic permission.

CLEAN-REPLAY.behavior: The proof and runtime matrix replays from pinned tools and records the evidence even if a check fails.

LEGAL-CLIENTS.criterion: Concrete documented legal Boolean clients complete under the matching nightly

VERIFIER-SOURCE.criterion: The verifier processes the current source or a mechanically justified specialization

BOOL-PERMISSIONS.criterion: Current-source proofs and controls establish lifetime, validity and race freedom

PRIMITIVE-BOUNDARY.criterion: Review the ordinary store intrinsic contracts and tool assumptions

SPECIALIZED-CONSTRUCTOR.criterion: Prove Boolean constructor fresh and shared cases for the specialized layout and reject invalid controls

CONSTRUCTOR-SOURCE.criterion: Compare specialized and original constructor layouts and MIR, rejecting a change to the pointer computation

ORDINARY-STORE.criterion: Prove the current ordinary Boolean store including its intrinsic ordering and volatility arguments

STORE-SOURCE.criterion: Compare the current and specialized store layout and compiled dispatch, rejecting a changed ordering

ORDINARY-LOAD.criterion: Prove ordinary Boolean loads including all three legal orderings and both panic paths

LOAD-SOURCE.criterion: Compare compiled current and specialized Boolean load dispatch and reject a changed ordering

MIXED-BYTE-PERMISSIONS.criterion: Prove coexistence and recovery of raw read permissions and reject a write with only the atomic read fraction

SCOPED-REFERENCE-PERMISSIONS.criterion: Check reference construction, two read permissions, lifetime end and Boolean recovery, rejecting early scope end and a store

SCOPED-REFERENCE-SOURCE.criterion: Compare compiled reference cast and read operations with the fork and reject an ordering change

STD-SCOPED-THREADS.criterion: Check the actual scoped-thread API including transfer of reader permissions and return at join

U16-CONSTRUCTOR-AND-ACCESS.criterion: Verify fresh and existing AtomicU16 shares and all ordinary load and store ordering branches

U16-MIXED-WIDTH.criterion: Admit the disjoint atomic byte writer and reject both overlapping byte writers on missing permission

U16-SOURCE.criterion: Match compiled AtomicU16 constructor/load/store and reject altered pointer, ordering and layout

PTR-CONSTRUCTOR.criterion: Verify fresh and reused AtomicPtr shares for pointee sizes 0, 1, 2, 3 and 4 and recover the slot after the modeled lifetime

PTR-SOURCE.criterion: Compare all five compiled pointer constructors and reject an altered slot address

PTR-CLIENT.criterion: Exercise null, dangling, address-only and live pointer values, and dereference a live pointer after each valid store and load ordering pair under Miri

INTEGER-CONSTRUCTOR-MATRIX.criterion: Verify all ten required integer constructor specializations with initialized storage, lifetime, alignment, and ownership recovery controls

CONSTRUCTOR-COVERAGE-REPLAY.criterion: Compare compiled constructor bodies, detect changed slot addresses, and confirm all required constructors ran on eligible targets

PTR-ORDINARY-ACCESS.criterion: Prove ordinary thin pointer loads and stores for the five covered pointee sizes and reject a fractional write, an illegal ordering, volatility and a wide pointer

PTR-ACCESS-SOURCE.criterion: Match compiled pointer-typed load and store branches and detect changed load and store orderings

SWAP-PERMISSIONS.criterion: Verify all five exchange ordering branches for AtomicBool, the integer matrix and the five thin pointer specializations, and reject invalid Boolean values, read-only permission and wide pointers

SWAP-SOURCE.criterion: Compare the compiled exchange dispatches against the pinned source and detect changed orderings and changed return values

SWAP-CLIENT.criterion: Check the previous value and replacement under all five orderings with native and Miri clients, including dereferencing a returned live pointer

CAS-PERMISSIONS.criterion: Verify strong and weak compare-exchange across all covered slot types and reject an invalid Boolean byte, a read-only byte fraction, and a release failure ordering at the primitive boundary

CAS-SOURCE.criterion: Compare every success and failure ordering pair against the pinned compiler output and detect mutations to either ordering, the result variant and weak versus strong lowering

CAS-CLIENT.criterion: Exercise the success, mismatch, invalid ordering and spurious failure paths with native and Miri clients

ARITHMETIC-PERMISSIONS.criterion: Verify all five orderings for both operations across the integer and pointer matrix. Reject fractional write permission, restricted value invariants and the wrong pointer delta type.

ARITHMETIC-SOURCE.criterion: Match compiled arithmetic and all five orderings against the pinned source. Detect a changed opcode, ordering and pointer element scale.

ARITHMETIC-CLIENT.criterion: Check previous values, wrapping integer limits, pointer address wraparound and restored live pointer dereferences with native and Miri clients.

BITWISE-PERMISSIONS.criterion: Verify bitwise methods on the Boolean, integer and pointer matrix. Reject fractional write permission, unsupported value invariants, an incorrect pointer mask type and invalid Boolean operations.

BITWISE-SOURCE.criterion: Match bitwise compiler lowering for all five orderings and detect opcode and ordering mutations. Verify that Boolean NAND selects XOR or exchange.

BITWISE-CLIENT.criterion: Check Boolean truth tables, integer bit patterns and pointer tagging and untagging in native and Miri clients.

EXTREMA-PERMISSIONS.criterion: Verify all five orderings across the integer matrix. Prove a restricted invariant for valid input and reject invalid values, write attempts with read permission and an intrinsic with the wrong signedness.

EXTREMA-SOURCE.criterion: Match compiled minimum and maximum dispatch and detect changes to memory ordering and comparison signedness.

EXTREMA-CLIENT.criterion: Check stored and previous values at signed and unsigned integer limits using native and Miri clients.

INTEGER-ACCESS-PERMISSIONS.criterion: Prove safe ordinary loads and stores for all 12 integer types with panic unwind and enforce read and write permissions. Reject invalid and volatile intrinsic calls.

INTEGER-ACCESS-SOURCE.criterion: Compare compiled load and store dispatch for all legal and panic orderings and detect a load or store ordering mutation.

INTEGER-ACCESS-CLIENT.criterion: Exercise boundary values and all load and store orderings with native tests and Miri on both proof targets.

CLEAN-LOCAL-REPLAY.criterion: A fresh verifier build and the complete matrix finish with no proof or test failures.

HOSTED-CI-REPLAY.criterion: The hosted GitHub Actions job finishes successfully and publishes the evidence artifact for the candidate commit.

SCOPED-THREAD-BOUNDARY.criterion: Confirm the real scoped-thread fixtures compile against the pinned Rust library and report the specific proof frontend blockers against a passing verifier control.

SOURCE-AND-CONTRACT-REVIEW.criterion: Independently review primitive contracts and the source comparisons using the Challenge 7 review guide.
